scope: admin.astro strict typing and verified UI corrections
full_astro_check: Parent-owned; round1 had no admin errors. Final combined gate remains parent-owned.
behavioral_fixes: Donation statistics status text uses its own unique span id; loading success/failure preserves status filter options.
Image-cleanup status reads server-provided nested data counts.
runtime_guards: Required DOM helpers check the expected constructor. Optional/dynamic nodes return null.
Navigation allows absent unlocked tabs, then falls back to a locked tab or an empty list.
Empty DragEvent dataTransfer returns no files; filesystem entry methods are narrowed by their actual runtime flags/methods.
Loaded manifest and persisted course UID are checked before file operations.
constraints: No ts-nocheck/ts-ignore, strict disablement, check exclusion, blanket any, or unknown double assertions.
No server files, production data, pushes, PRs, or commits changed by this agent.
limits: Synthetic DOM runs the actual extracted and TypeScript-compiled functions/bindings; it is not a full browser acceptance test.
TypeScript declarations describe server contracts; they do not add schema validation to every successful JSON response.
